title: What If All Insects Disappeared? The Chain Reaction Explained
short_title: What if every insect vanished tomorrow? 🐝 #shorts
description:
No more mosquitoes, flies or wasps… sounds like paradise? Think again. Without insects, flowers lose their pollinators, birds lose their food, and nature loses its clean-up crew. Here is the chain reaction, step by step.
